methodology_verification.clip_model_loading_handling: CLIPModel and CLIPProcessor are instantiated once during startup; warm inference timing excludes model weights download and initialization.

split_difficulty_divergence.split_c_difficulty_note: Specimens in Split C consist of extreme close-up carvings, night views, and partial structures that create ambiguous margins (<0.10), triggering full local feature verification on 27/28 specimens.
split_difficulty_divergence.split_b_difficulty_note: Specimens in Split B contain more standard frontal architectural views where global CLIP provides clear separation, allowing 18.18% to exit via the fast-path.

phase_cross_comparison.phase_8_1_explanation: Unconditionally executed SIFT + FLANN + Local CLIP multi-crop on 100% of queries on CPU (285 + 163 + 461 = 909 ms).
phase_cross_comparison.phase_8_2_explanation: Measured primarily on fast-path-dominated runs where local features were bypassed on clear views.
phase_cross_comparison.phase_8_2d_explanation: Measured across the combined realistic corpus (Split B + Split C, N=83) with conditional gating active.
